content.title: Continuous Follow | Gait and Curved Landmarks Mark Progress
content.summary: Use one uninterrupted rear follow through a curved constrained passage. Keep gait and frame position stable while repeated lights, rail seams, and ribs become a countable progress clock; shift the vanishing point with the curve and stop at a visibly deeper position without inventing a threshold, encounter, or reroute.

quick_start.input_format: Single subject + continuous rear following + repeated structural landmarks + curved route parallax + visible progress final state without cutting the mirror
quick_start.recommended_input: A pipeline inspector continues to advance along the curved underground corridor, repeating the light strips, arch ribs and joints as a progress clock; the camera always follows behind and does not include discovery or crossing events.
required_anchors: Begin with one stable rear-follow relationship inside a constrained passage.
Use repeated fixed landmarks as countable progress evidence.
Let passage curvature shift the vanishing point gradually.
End at a materially farther position on the same route.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Use one uninterrupted rear follow through a curved constrained passage. Keep gait and frame position stable while repeated lights, rail seams, and ribs become a countable progress clock; shift the vanishing point with the curve and stop at a visibly deeper position without inventing a threshold, encounter, or reroute.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Use one uninterrupted rear follow in a constrained curved passage. Keep the subject's gait and screen position stable while repeated fixed lights, rail joints and wall ribs pass as a countable progress clock; let the changing tunnel curvature slowly shift the vanishing point, then hold a visibly farther position without inventing a threshold, encounter or route change.

invariants.rule: Begin with one stable rear-follow relationship inside a constrained passage.
invariants.purpose: Makes later progress measurable against the body.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing follow distance hides the route clock.

invariants.rule: Use repeated fixed landmarks as countable progress evidence.
Keep gait, travel axis and body scale stable through the middle.
invariants.purpose: Separates environmental geometry change from performance change.
invariants.ablation_failure: Speed ramps or body jumps fake progress.

invariants.rule: Let passage curvature shift the vanishing point gradually.
invariants.purpose: Adds visible geometric evolution without a new event.
invariants.ablation_failure: A sudden turn creates a different mechanism.

invariants.rule: End at a materially farther position on the same route.
invariants.ablation_failure: Inventing a threshold or discovery exceeds the source.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source curved walkway, pipes and light sequence
